value.rationale: Quantifies the dependence concealed by the joint Poisson limit in the standard no-fixed-point Ewens model. For all pairs of fixed distinct cycle lengths, theta=1 exhibits strict alternating factorial dependence at every allowed sample size, whereas theta≠1 has a universal parameter-dependent n^-2 coefficient with a sharp sign boundary at theta=1. These are motivated global classifications, not a narrow arbitrary table or routine numerical increment.
